confidence_notes: Kenting is not in standard cost indexes, so food and drink rest on Kenting guide and blog ranges from search (street food NT$50-150, typical restaurant meal about NT$200, beer NT$100-200, cocktails NT$150-350). They also use a Kenting aggregator table dated July 2023 (traveltables.com) and Kaohsiung comparator figures of unclear provenance. No direct Kenting cappuccino or wine-by-the-glass prices were found. Coffee is bounded between the 2023 Kenting figure and the Kaohsiung figure, and wine is inferred from the local beer/cocktail relationship (about 1.9x beer). NT$ prices were converted at an assumed NT$31 per USD that I did not search. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no live listings checked, for blended July peak-season weekday/weekend rates. They are the least certain because Kenting prices swing sharply on weekends and holidays. The FX figure comes from RBA pages surfaced by a single search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taiwan-wide price level anchored on Kaohsiung (nearest large city), with a modest tourist-resort premium for Kenting in July peak season. Kenting-specific guide ranges were used where found. Accommodation reflects a seasonal beach-resort market rather than a city market.
